source.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version-laguna-iq2.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-directory /tmp/laguna-q2-xl-q5-pair-profile-35b1602e5-short --output-file epyc -- .venv/bin/python -u /tmp/laguna_decode_profile_child.py /models/gguf/Laguna-S-2.1-UD-Q2_K_XL.gguf --prompts benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --prompt-id code_merge_intervals --backend hip_gfx1100 --context-length 4096 --chunk-size 128 --decode-tokens 16 --compiler-version-file /tmp/hipengine-hipcc-version-laguna-iq2.txt --output /tmp/laguna-q2-xl-q5-pair-profile-35b1602e5-short/bench.json

families.scope: 47 attention-output projections plus layer-0 dense gate/up
47 attention query projections plus their 47 same-input attention gates

selected_candidate.name: exact_q5_attention_query_gate_pair_dispatch
selected_candidate.scope: 47 rows=1 same-input Q5_K attention query/gate pairs with K3072 and unequal output widths
selected_candidate.design: one flattened pack grid maps each workgroup to either the query or gate tensor, invokes the existing exact Q5 singleton device block with that projection's output width, and returns separate F32 outputs without idle padding
selected_candidate.fallback: the separately registered query and gate singleton launches remain the unfused path for rows>1, registry misses, unsupported shapes, and unmeasured backends
selected_candidate.red_gate: synthetic K3072 N9216+72 and N6144+48 output must be F32 byte-exact to the two singleton launches; unsupported shapes must decline to singleton fallback
selected_candidate.performance_gate: actual-weight paired query+gate wall must improve in both SWA and global shapes; clean full-model kernel sum/span and canonical category decode/E2E must be non-regressive with exact IDs/state/KV/lifecycle

kernel_only_ceiling.assumption: the 0.598314 ms gate work overlaps completely without slowing query work; host launch savings excluded

notes: This artifact reuses an already-retained clean D5 trace and makes no new throughput claim.
Encoded-weight bandwidth is a source-byte proxy, not a hardware counter; activations, cache-line waste, and dequant compute are excluded.
The selected candidate is shape/quant/rows qualified and contains no prompt, token, category, or route-ID condition.
The query/gate pair cannot reach 50 tok/s by itself under its kernel-only ceiling; remaining attention-output Q5, IQ2/IQ3, and submission wall must be reprofiled after any retention.
